 Kenneth Walker , RB (KC) 
 Sits out Friday's practice
 Home   >  News 
 Nov 13 7:18pm 
 Walker (groin) sat out Friday's practice due to groin tightness, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.
 Per McDowell, coach Andy Reid noted of Walker on Friday, "we'll see how he feels through this afternoon, with rehab, and through tomorrow." Based on this report, there's a good chance Walker will be deemed questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons. If he ends up limited or out this weekend, the door would be open for rookie Emmett Johnson to step into an expanded role in Week 10.

 Coach Andy Reid noted that Johnson would take the bulk of the Chiefs' carries in the event that Kenneth Walker -- who didn't practice Friday due to groin tightness -- is forced to miss Sunday's game against the Falcons, Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.
